brandStory.subtitle: WHY WE STARTED
brandStory.title:
For the moment
no one cared about
brandStory.p1: After hiking, your face stings. After surfing, your skin feels tight. After running, your cheeks burn.
brandStory.p2: But there was nothing you could use in that moment. Sunscreen is for before. Skincare is for home. For hours in between, your skin was just left on its own.
brandStory.p3: In a multi-billion dollar skincare market, the category of instant post-activity recovery simply didn't exist.
brandStory.p4: So we decided to build it. Products you can use right there, right after. That's how SUACI started.

brand.p2: SUACI enters that structural gap. Instantly cooling and soothing skin exhausted by UV, sweat, and dust, while rapidly replenishing moisture to the damaged barrier.
